capture.inputActuation: MacBook Force Touch press-to-click while the finger remains in contact
capture.triggerMarker: visible Safari trigger-count transition synchronously produced by pointerdown
capture.acousticOnset: first frame of the externally recorded 880 Hz onset after slow-motion time expansion
capture.calibrationBasis: conservative 60 Hz display refresh interval plus one 240 fps capture frame; applied after clipping negative same-frame quantization to zero
